title: CBO's Estimates of the Budgetary Effects of Increasing Funding for the Health Care Fraud and Abuse Control Account
summary_raw: In CBO's estimation, activities funded by the Health Care Fraud and Abuse Control account generate a substantial return on investment in the form of recoveries to the government and reduced spending.

title: A Privilege to Lead CBO
summary_raw: Phillip Swagel's second term as CBO's Director ends in January, and he will then return to his faculty position at the University of Maryland.
